submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "Breastfeeding After C-Section in a Crowded Compound"
finding.problem: "Everyone wants to watch the baby feed. I can't find a position that doesn't pull my wound, and I'm too shy to ask them to leave the room."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 23-yr-old newlywed in a joint-family household (Ibadan); mother-in-law and aunties hover; she needs football/side-lying hold but has zero privacy and pain lifting baby to latch.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone mini-guide (CS breastfeeding positions + privacy scripts).". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
